MartyrRecord.title: MartyrRecord
MartyrRecord.description: Represents a deceased believer or martyr in Rawdat Al-Shuhada wal-Mutawaffeen for reciting Surah Al-Fatiha.

name.description: Full name of the deceased or martyr.

deathDate.description: Hijri or Gregorian date of passing.

photoUrl.description: Optional URL to portrait photo of the deceased.

bio.description: Optional short tribute, title, or hometown (e.g., من شهداء الصلاة بالأحساء / المدينة المنورة).

fatihaCount.description: Total number of Surah Al-Fatiha recitations gifted to their soul.

isVisible.description: Public visibility flag for list queries.

/martyrs/{martyrId}.description: Public memorial cards for Rawdat Al-Shuhada wal-Mutawaffeen.
